title: Coco Peila releases a new track "I Am Jane Roe" (Feat. MADlines & RyanNicole)
htmlContent:
Coco Peila returns with a new track called "I Am Jane Roe" featuring MADlines & RyanNicole, with them putting their talents together to achieve the goal of making super dope music. It doesn’t lack in any category of Hip Hop and is a record you should listen to right now!

The single "I Am Jane Roe" is one of the most exciting songs you will hear present day. It’s a record that has an unlimited amount of melodies, that you can feel that is on another level, and can only come from a true musical master of their work.
